title: feat(examples): dataset members carry a business description and its bundle translations
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34873
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:app-todo 与 app-showcase 的全部 39 个数据集成员(维度与度量)各加一句业务 `description`,并在各应用已有的非英文语言包里补上对应译文(app-todo:zh-CN、ja-JP;app-showcase:zh-CN)。
- **为什么改**:示例是作者照抄的样板;此前成员只有 `synonyms`,抄过去只学到一半词汇。现在与 app-crm 的写法一致。
- **风险与回滚**:仅示例元数据与译文、外加两处示例测试,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/revenue-pulse.dataset.ts`(`total_home_sum` 与 `revenue_sum` 的业务口径)、`examples/app-todo/src/datasets/task.dataset.ts`、`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` 的 zh-CN `datasets` 段。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm check:i18n-coverage`,预期输出 `OK (14 config(s), 423 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`examples/app-todo/src/datasets/task.dataset.ts`**: all 9 members (6 dimensions, 3 measures) of `todo_task_metrics` gain a one-sentence business `description`, in the pattern of `examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts` (a plain business definition, not an instruction to a model).
- **`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/{chart-gallery,revenue-pulse}.dataset.ts`**: all 30 members of `showcase_task_metrics` (10), `showcase_project_metrics` (6), `showcase_invoice_metrics` (8) and `showcase_account_metrics` (6) gain the same. The one-line member literals that now carry a description are unfolded to one key group per line.
- **Bundle translations**, at the key the i18n walk and resolver read, `datasets.NAME.{dimensions,measures}.MEMBER.description` (verified in `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` and the spec's `datasets` translation schema; the same shape app-crm uses), in every non-source locale each app already carries: app-todo `zh-CN.ts` and `ja-JP.ts` (18 entries), app-showcase `zh-CN` (30 entries, merged into the existing `datasets` block beside its labels). Hand-written translations, terms aligned with each bundle's existing field and option labels. `en` gets no entry: it is the source locale, read from the dataset itself, and app-crm carries none either.
- **Pins** (into the existing harness files, as top-level `describe`s): `examples/app-todo/src/translations/translation-completeness.test.ts` asserts each member declares a description and that zh-CN and ja-JP carry a translated one that is not the English; `examples/app-showcase/test/zh-cn-chart-gallery-measure-labels.test.ts` runs the app's four datasets through `translateMetadataDocument` and asserts every member authors a description and is served a Chinese one under zh-CN.

## Tests

All readings at head `a7d31949`.

- **i18n-coverage baseline: unchanged, 106 → 106 (app-todo) and 317 → 317 (app-showcase).** `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exit 0: `OK (14 config(s), 423 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. The card's estimate of 106 → 124 is the count with the descriptions authored but *untranslated* (9 members × 2 locales = 18); each new description is translated in every non-source locale here, so the ratchet does not move and `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` is not edited. Control leg (to show the gate actually sees description keys): with the 9 zh-CN descriptions removed from app-todo, `os lint --json` reports `datasets.todo_task_metrics.*.description` missing for zh-CN; restored from `HEAD` (hash matches the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty). At head, `os lint --json` reports zero dataset `description` findings for either app. The remaining dataset findings are the pre-existing untranslated member *labels* (18 in app-todo, 25 in app-showcase), already in the frozen baseline.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo validate` / `typecheck` / `test`: exit 0 / 0 / 0 (Test Files 9/9, Tests 267/267).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` / `typecheck` / `test`: exit 0 / 0 / 0 (Test Files 48/48, Tests 549/549). `Validation passed`. Neither app's validate prints any `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` or other dataset finding.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 8 changed files: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation of the two new pins (one per pin, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restored to HEAD and verified)</summary>

- Showcase: deleted the zh-CN `paid_count` description line. Result: `1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, `showcase_invoice_metrics.paid_count serves no zh-CN description`. Restored: `blob == HEAD (bf9a9f13546b) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- Todo: replaced the ja-JP `priority` description with the English text. Result: `1 failed | 92 passed (93)`, the not-the-English assertion. Restored: `blob == HEAD (495ea54ccefd) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- No rebuild needed: both suites import the example sources by relative path; the only dist import (`@objectstack/spec`) is untouched by the diff.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset: none, and `skip-changeset` is requested on create.** Both `@objectstack/example-todo` and `@objectstack/example-showcase` are `private: true`; the diff publishes nothing from any released package (the private-package fast lane).
- The dataset member **labels** in both apps stay untranslated in zh-CN/ja-JP, as before; they are pre-existing baselined debt (the showcase bundle's own comment says so) and out of this card's scope, which is the description entries.
- The descriptions state each member's business scope (for example, that counts and sums cover every status, that `total_home_sum` is converted into the home currency, and that `revenue_sum` is each account company's own annual revenue, not what it is billed). They introduce no number or rule that the metadata does not already carry.

- 41 exit 0, including `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:examples-live-imports`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:published-files`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it reads every package's built `dist/`, and only the CLI and the two examples' closures were built here). CI runs it on this PR.
